verdict.rationale: Composio's docs explicitly describe a small fixed set of 7 meta-tools that let agents discover, authorize, and execute tools across 1000+ apps at runtime instead of loading all tool definitions into context, with options to restrict toolkits or expose via MCP for exact tool sets. This is well documented with concrete API examples and consistent across multiple doc pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmark or third-party corroboration of context-size savings in practice.
